notes: Two branches joined by «ح»; the names written once after the last «ح» (Amr, Tawus, Ibn Abbas) are the shared tail
«- وهذا لفظ مسدد -» and «قال سليمان بن حرب حتى يستوفيه» are wording notes and are left out
«زاد مسدد قال وقال ابن عباس وأحسب» is Ibn Abbas's further words inside the same chain, not a separate isnad
